scope: 40 entries actually cited by v51, including appendices. Uncited historical bibliography entries are retained and are outside this audit.
method: Google Scholar visible search results, DBLP publicly indexed records, and original proceedings, publisher or author pages. DBLP API returned an anti-bot page, so it was not used as metadata. Missing DBLP matches are not treated as verification.
conflicts: S4M: DBLP conference entry lists Peng Jing, but official ICLR proceedings and arXiv list Jing Peng. Retained Peng, Jing and corrected title.
GAIN: DBLP displays 5675-5684, whereas official PMLR lists 5689-5698. Used PMLR.
Bandit Algorithms: Google Scholar displays 2019 on one record. Used publisher publication date 2020.
Chronos: author list differs across versions. Used arXiv v3 list including Hao Wang, and retained the TMLR 2024 publication.
Chronos-Bolt: no standalone matching Scholar paper identified. Cited official 2024 release announcement as a blog, not a peer-reviewed article.
